articles.summary: KING OF PRUSSIA, Pa. , Sept. 10, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Universal Health Realty Income Trust (NYSE:UHT) announced today that its Board of Trustees voted to pay a dividend of $.74 per share on September 30, 2025 to shareholders of record as of September 22, 2025 .
articles.title: UNIVERSAL HEALTH REALTY INCOME TRUST ANNOUNCES DIVIDEND
